camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi ModifyInstance --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --ModifyType Upgrade --ProductCode rds
description_en: Modifies the resource configuration of an instance. Invoking this operation creates an order for the Upgrade/Downgrade of instance resources and processes automatic payment. This operation does not support configuration changes for ECS or RDS products. Use the dedicated API of the corresponding product to execute the Upgrade/Downgrade
description_zh: 对实例资源配置进行变更。调用接口会创建一个变配实例资源的订单，并自动支付。该接口不支持ECS和RDS 系列产品的变更，请查找对应产品的专有API执行变配
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi modify-instance --product-code rds --subscription-type Subscription --modify-type Upgrade --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstance

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of configuration change. Valid values:
Upgrade: upgrade.
Downgrade: downgrade
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值
Upgrade：升级。
Downgrade：降级
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance whose configuration you want to modify
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止请求重复提交
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The code of the nth module property. Valid values of n: 1 to 100. If multiple module properties exist, concatenate the parameters in the format of n=1,2,3…n.

Specify only the module properties that need to be changed. For example, if only property A needs to be changed among properties A and B, pass only the information related to property A
fields.help_zh:
第n个模块属性code配置，n的取值范围为（1~100），如有多个模块属性参数，按照n=1,2,3…n的形式拼接多个参数。

只设置需要变更配置的模块属性信息，如A,B两个属性中，只有A需要变更配置，则只传A属性相关即可
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The value of the nth module property. Valid values of n: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 第n个模块属性value配置，n的取值范围为（1~100）
fields.name: value

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the order that was created

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
